items.name: theme
items.title: Fragiola theme
items.description: The global stylesheet: @theme inline with the six palette roles, the highlighted and field-focus custom variants, chart token axes, density, radius and --height-control. The chart categorical derivation block lives here (theme machinery, not a palette).

items.name: palette-surface
items.title: Surface palette
items.description: The neutral floor palette. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-raised
items.title: Raised palette
items.description: Elevated surface (card, popover, dialog). Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-blue
items.title: Blue palette
items.description: Chromatic palette, hue ~250. The colour IS the element: CTA, badge, marked control. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-green
items.title: Green palette
items.description: Chromatic palette, hue ~150. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-orange
items.title: Orange palette
items.description: Chromatic palette, hue ~55. Distinct from danger (hue ~25). Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-purple
items.title: Purple palette
items.description: Chromatic palette, hue ~300. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-rose
items.title: Rose palette
items.description: Chromatic palette, hue ~345. Distinct from danger (hue ~25) — reads as pink, not as an error state. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-surface-blue
items.title: Surface-blue palette
items.description: Neutral surface with a blue focus ring (~250). Neutrals identical to surface; only --palette-ring is chromatic. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-surface-purple
items.title: Surface-purple palette
items.description: Neutral surface with a purple focus ring (~300). Neutrals identical to surface; only --palette-ring is chromatic. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-surface-green
items.title: Surface-green palette
items.description: Neutral surface with a green focus ring (~150). Neutrals identical to surface; only --palette-ring is chromatic. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-surface-orange
items.title: Surface-orange palette
items.description: Neutral surface with an orange focus ring (~55). Neutrals identical to surface; only --palette-ring is chromatic. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-surface-rose
items.title: Surface-rose palette
items.description: Neutral surface with a rose focus ring (~345). Neutrals identical to surface; only --palette-ring is chromatic. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-danger
items.title: Danger palette
items.description: Error, destructive action. Hue ~25. Applied automatically by [data-invalid]. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn helper
items.description: clsx + extendTailwindMerge with a palette class group so cn("palette-blue", "palette-danger") resolves to one.

items.name: get-token
items.title: getToken helper
items.description: Reads a CSS custom property from the document, with px/rem formatting and a fallback.

items.name: text
items.title: Text atom
items.description: Heading, Paragraph, Link, Small, Label, Error, Strong, Highlight, Clickable. No react-twc, no router coupling. Text.Link is a plain <a>; consumers wire Next's or TanStack's Link through render.

items.name: clickable
items.title: Clickable
items.description: The button surface — Button, Link and ExternalLink under one namespace. Three orthogonal axes (variant: solid/ghost/outline/icon, size: sm/md, shape: auto/square), none of which is colour. Tone arrives as a palette class. Link is a plain <a>; consumers stitch a router link through render. ExternalLink is a separate export for its outbound defaults.

items.name: icon-size
items.title: iconSize table
items.description: Icon sizes by context as Tailwind classes. The documented escape from 'which size does an icon use here'.

items.name: popup
items.title: popup family
items.description: The floating box family — one member, content. Zero variants. Carries the box (raised palette, border, radius, shadow), sizing from Base UI's positioner, open/close animations and per-side slide-in including logical inline-start/inline-end with rtl counterparts. Shared by dropdown-menu, context-menu, select and combobox.

items.name: menu
items.title: menu family + parts factory
items.description: The option list family — item, selectableItem, label, separator, shortcut, subTrigger, itemIndicator. Zero variants. Plus createMenuParts(P): a factory that takes a Base UI menu namespace and returns the styled wrappers (Item, SelectableItem, Label, Separator, Group, Shortcut, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup, RadioItem, SubTrigger, SubContent, Content, Sub). Shared by dropdown-menu, context-menu, select and combobox.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions triggered by a button. Declares only Root, Trigger, Content and SubContent with its own positioning defaults — everything else comes from the menu parts factory. No tone/variant/destructive prop; tone arrives as a palette class.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu of actions triggered by right-click. Declares only Root, Trigger (with select-none — behavioural, not visual), Content and SubContent. Installing after dropdown-menu writes exactly one file — the shared families are already on disk.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: The field family (root, choiceRoot, row, body, control, addon, inset, label, description, error — zero variants) plus the Field composition stitching Base UI's Field primitive to the family via render. The box is the row; the control is only its middle. Invalid state by inheritance from data-invalid. Addon sides via data-side in logical vocabulary.

items.name: input
items.title: Input / Textarea / Numeric
items.description: One input component — Input, Textarea and Numeric. None carry a border, background, height, radius, focus ring, invalid state or theme; the box comes from the row. Numeric is the thesis test: a control written from scratch with no box styling. Includes Input.Template.Simple — a composition template with at most 7 props, no appearance props.

items.name: choice
items.title: choice family
items.description: The checkable controls family — root, control, indicator, label, description. Zero variants. Shared by Checkbox, Radio and Switch. data-checked fills with palette-base and swaps text to contrast.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkable box. Uses the choice family's root (the box) and indicator (the check icon). Base UI's Checkbox provides checked/unchecked/indeterminate states, keyboard and aria.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio + RadioGroup
items.description: A checkable circle. Uses the choice family's root (the circle, rounded-full) and indicator (a filled dot). RadioGroup provides the group behaviour and keyboard navigation.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A toggle. Uses the choice family's root (the track, w-9 h-5 rounded-full) and control (the thumb that slides). data-checked fills the track with palette-base.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The recombination test: field + popup + menu, declaring no new style. Trigger uses field.row + field.control; Content uses popup.content; Item uses menu.selectableItem; Indicator uses menu.itemIndicator. Installing after dropdown-menu and field writes exactly one file.

items.name: layer
items.title: layer family + parts factory
items.description: The backdrop + panel family — backdrop, panel, header, body, footer, title, description. Zero variants. The backdrop uses bg-scrim (outside the palette contract — a scrim is not a role). title/description carry no typography (Text through render). Plus createLayerParts(P): a factory that takes a Base UI overlay namespace (Dialog or AlertDialog) and returns the styled wrappers. Shared by dialog, alert-dialog and drawer.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal layer — a centred panel over a scrim. Consumes the layer family through createLayerParts; declares only Root, Trigger, Portal and the centring transform. Title renders Text.Heading as="h2" through render; Description renders Text.Paragraph. The close affordance is Clickable.Button variant="icon" shape="square" size="sm" with an sr-only label, positioned with logical properties.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal layer that requires an explicit action to dismiss — no backdrop click, no close button. This file is the proof that layer is a family: it declares only what genuinely differs from dialog (the namespace, showClose={false}, the action/cancel pair). Installing after dialog writes exactly one file. A destructive confirmation is className="palette-danger" on the action button.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: An edge-anchored layer with real swipe and snap-point support, built on Base UI's Drawer primitive. Consumes the layer family directly (panel, header, body, footer, title, description) but is not built from createLayerParts — it has its own Viewport, Handle and a transform-based positioning model. The inline edges invert under RTL. This is why sheet does not exist: an edge-anchored dialog and a drawer are the same component.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: An ECharts wrapper that resolves the active theme's tokens and applies them to axes, series and tooltip. The chart tokens are a separate axis from the palette contract — no role describes 'the third series'. Includes useThemeTokens hook (MutationObserver on data-theme). Thin wrapper: consumer passes a full EChartsOption, wrapper only injects colours.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A transient text label that appears on hover or focus. Composes popup.tooltip — a new member of the popup family, not a variant of popup.content. Inverted palette (accent as background, base as text), no border, no shadow, compact padding, fade-only animation. Provider coordinates delay between siblings.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating surface positioned against a trigger. Composes popup.content (the same floating box dropdown-menu uses) and adds Title, Description and Close through render. Title renders Text.Heading as="h2"; Description renders Text.Paragraph. The close affordance is Clickable.Button variant="icon" positioned with logical properties.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: disclosure family
items.description: The expand/collapse family — trigger, panel, content. Zero variants. trigger is the toggle button (group for chevron rotation, w-full, justify-between, logical padding, hover on soft, focus ring). panel is the animated container (overflow-hidden, data-starting-style/data-ending-style fade). content is the inner padded content (p-4 pt-0). Shared by accordion and collapsible.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A group of expand/collapse items with coordination. Composes the disclosure family (trigger, panel, content). Declares only Root, Item and Header — the coordination points. openMultiple controls whether one or many items can be open. The trigger is a group; put a chevron inside with group-data-[panel-open]:rotate-180.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single expand/collapse section. Composes the disclosure family (trigger, panel, content). An accordion is a group of collapsibles with coordination; a collapsible is one section on its own. Both share the same trigger, panel and content — the zero-variant rule is preserved.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small status indicator. One axis (variant: soft / solid / outline), none of which is colour. Tone arrives as a palette class (palette-danger, palette-blue, etc.) — no variant="destructive", no tone prop. The palette class overrides the six roles, so bg-palette-soft becomes the danger soft tint and text-palette-contrast becomes the danger contrast.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A navigation trail. Uses a semantic nav with an ordered list. The last item is the current page (aria-current), not a link. Separators are chevrons on the inline axis, RTL-aware. No variants — visual differences (separator type, truncation) are composition. Breadcrumb.Ellipsis for collapsed items.

items.name: track
items.title: track family
items.description: A rail with a filled portion — the two things slider and progress genuinely share. Two members (rail, fill), zero variants. Orientation is data-orientation from the primitive, not a style axis. The fill's geometry comes from the primitive's inline styles (logical properties, so RTL inverts automatically); the family carries only the visual treatment. Installing slider after progress writes exactly one file.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: The rail without the interaction. Determinate and indeterminate; the indeterminate animation respects prefers-reduced-motion. Fills from the inline start and inverts under RTL (logical properties from the primitive). Tone arrives as a palette class from outside (palette-orange), not a prop. Uses the track family (rail + fill).

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A field control — the thesis test of the control/body rule for a non-text control. Carries no border, background, height, focus ring or invalid state of its own; all of that arrives from field.row. The Control carries the field-control marker so the row's outline fires on focus. The thumb's own focus ring uses palette-ring. Range sliders work with the same component. Uses the track family (rail + fill). Installing after progress writes exactly one file.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A strip of triggers where one is current, with an animated indicator. The indicator uses the primitive's CSS variables (--active-tab-*), not React measurement — it tracks on resize and under RTL automatically. Orientation is behaviour from the primitive. Focus ring is palette-ring; the active state is a role (bg-palette-soft), not a colour. No navigation family — tabs and navigation-menu share state normalisation (highlighted) but not enough structural style. The negative result is in the port report.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A strip of triggers where each opens a morphing popup with a viewport that resizes between items. The popup is popup.content (the second consumer outside menus). The viewport morphs via the primitive's --popup-width/--popup-height CSS variables — no new popup member, no !important. Link renders Text.Link through render. The trigger's chevron rotates on open and sits on the inline end (ms-auto).

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A strip of links where one is the current page. Every clickable part is Clickable — Link for pages, Previous/Next as Clickable.Link with an icon. No button style in this file. The current page carries aria-current=page and is distinguished by a fill strategy (variant=outline), never by a colour. Previous/next chevrons invert under RTL via rtl:rotate-180. Ships no page-computation logic.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: The second recombination test. This component is field + popup + menu, and it declares no new style. The input is a field control (field.row + field-control marker); the trigger and clear buttons are Clickable.Button; the content is popup.content; items are menu.selectableItem; the item indicator is menu.itemIndicator; group labels are menu.label; separators are menu.separator. If this file contains a class that does not come from a family, the recombination claim is wrong. It does not. Supports single and multiple selection (with chips).

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic HTML with palette roles. No primitive, no family. border-palette-line for the grid, bg-palette-soft for the header and hover, text-palette-contrast for header text, text-palette-accent/85 for body text. The wrapper handles horizontal scroll on small screens.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A profile picture with a fallback. Uses Base UI primitive for the loading-status state machine. No family — just palette roles and layout. Size is controlled by the consumer via className (default size-10).

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder for loading content. No primitive, no family. bg-palette-soft (a role) + animate-pulse (Tailwind built-in, respects prefers-reduced-motion automatically). Shape controlled by consumer via className.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A visual divider. Uses Base UI primitive for ARIA (role=separator, aria-orientation). No family — the menu family separator carries menu spacing. This separator is generic: bg-palette-line (a role) + orientation from primitive. Horizontal: h-px w-full. Vertical: h-full w-px.
